PlussMa ts¶

ts is PlussMa’s time-series framework: the transforms, tests, models and forecasters that work on an ordered series or a matrix of series.

Public Positioning¶

Reach for ts when the order of the observations matters. For an independent sample use the distribution and inference frameworks.

Include Surface¶

#include <pluss/ma.h>

Public Namespace¶

namespace ts = pluss::subsp::stats::ts;

Prose and signatures on this reference spell the namespace out as ts::; runnable examples declare the alias above.

Families¶

Family

What it owns

transforms

changes, shifts, rolling and exponentially weighted statistics, gap filling

diagnostics

autocorrelation, partial autocorrelation and the Ljung-Box, ADF, KPSS and ARCH-LM tests

arima

ARIMA and seasonal ARIMA models fitted by exact maximum likelihood

volatility

GARCH, GJR and EGARCH variance models and their constant-correlation multivariate forms

vector

vector autoregressions, impulse responses, Granger tests, cointegration and error-correction models

statespace

the Kalman filter, smoother, forecasts and simulation for linear Gaussian state-space models

forecasting

time-series partitions, direct multi-horizon forecasters, cross-validated loss and the Diebold-Mariano test

plot

autocorrelation and residual plots and their payloads
